candidate_identity: game/player/stat/threshold/period/rule-equivalence-class; both sides and cross-book offers retained separately
selection: First ten enumerated eligible economic contracts ordered by official kickoff/game_id/player_id/stat_order/threshold before model-edge review; retain all rejected attempts. Observed frame only.
books_and_jurisdiction_missing_reason: No complete eligible public quote source independently verified in bounded access test; freeze supported list before pilot capture.
freshness_basis: Specific market/line source modification time, never newest board constituent timestamp
pregame_guard: decision_at strictly before independently verified kickoff; HOU-JAX09:30EDT excluded from10AM cohort
closing_policy: Last preserved active exact-contract observation before actual kickoff; report lag; if absent CLV unavailable.12:30checkpoint is not automatically close.
outcome_sources: Official NFL/team gamebook/statistics plus preserved named-book jurisdiction settlement terms; revision history retained
acceptance: All attempts accounted for; zero identity/time/settlement violations admitted; retain failures and missingness; up-to-ten sample establishes no predictive or profit edge.
future_deliverables: PRIME-DOT-20261014-008 pregame before10AM and later postgame critique remain pending actual execution
threshold_scope: Half-integer thresholds of integer-valued statistics only; integer thresholds excluded from this initial cohort
as_of_gate: All feature/model/training/calibration cutoffs and durable prediction recorded_at <= decision_at; preserve original forecasts, later revisions append only
